newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel steadier, low sulphur dull.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel steadier, low sulphur dull.

text.p: NWE high sulphur barge prices steadied on Wednesday, finding some light buying support in short covering for barges, traders said.
Cracked low sulphur trade stayed thin with slack demand balancing slightly tighter supplies.

High sulphur barges were traded and valued around $86 a tonne fob ARA in early business, unchanged from Tuesday's late levels with some light short covering supportive. However, trader said bunker demand was very thin.
Low sulphur barge markets were dull. The market was pegged around Friday's late levels with buyers and sellers at standoff.
Sellers were unwilling to move offers lower from around $98 fob ARA and best bids were notionally pegged around $96 a tonne.
Cargo markets were very quiet, but prices were stable with crude holding steady at the lower levels after checking an early downside break below $19 a barrel on IPE futures.
Oversupply kept the North Sea dated Brent market looking soft around $18.08 a tonne.
